0.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_000
0.description: Adventure! Excitement! Glory! All that and more awaits you in the Diadem. Should you crave such delights in the depth of your soul, pray return to me when you have honed your skills.

1.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: In order to embark upon an Ishgardian exploratory mission, you and your party must meet the following requirements:

2.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_002
2.description: ※You must have completed the main scenario quest “Heavensward.”

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_003
3.description: You must be a level 60 Disciple of War or Magic.

4.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_004
4.description: To review your quest progression, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Journal<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

5.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_010
5.description: Excellent timing, my good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>! We seek volunteers for our next expedition. Will you be joining us?

6.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_Q1_000_000
6.description: What would you like to do?

7.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_A1_000_001
7.description: Register for an Ishgardian exploratory mission.

9.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_A1_000_003
9.description: Ask about rewards obtained during exploratory missions.

15.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_100
15.description: You have the opportunity to stand at the forefront of a grand initiative and explore a new frontier: the Diadem!

16.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_101
16.description: But know that you will face many difficulties. Why, the damn aether currents are so unstable that you have to attune to them every time...

17.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_100
17.description: In order to register for an exploratory mission, you must be a level 60 Disciple of War or Magic.

18.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_101
18.description: Furthermore, you must be in possession of a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>mission ceruleum voucher<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which may be purchased from Jaquoinie, the mission quartermaster.

19.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_102
19.description: Please be advised that preformed parties with less than eight players must abide by the composition requirement of one tank, two healers, and five DPS.

20.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_100_102
20.description: However, please note that these role requirements may only be enforced for exploratory missions to the Diadem Hunting Grounds.

21.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_103
21.description: Moreover, please note that the loot rules for matched parties prohibit the selection of Need.

22.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_104
22.description: Exploratory missions are limited to 30, 45, or 60 minutes (Earth time), depending on the difficulty selected.

23.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_100_104
23.description: Furthermore, please be advised that you will not be permitted to change to a Disciple of the Land or Hand while on an exploratory mission to the Diadem Hunting Grounds.

24.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_105
24.description: All items in a player's loot list will automatically be transferred to that player's inventory upon all other party members leaving the area.

25.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_106
25.description: Items unable to be obtained will be lost.

26.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_107
26.description: Please note that once you have participated in an exploratory mission, you may not do so again for 30 minutes (Earth time).

27.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_200
27.description: Oh, you never know what you might find out there, especially considering the number of expeditions being mounted by free companies and sky pirates─many of which fail miserably and are forced to withdraw.

28.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_201
28.description: Aye, people are dying out there. Greenhorns and seasoned veterans alike. And while that is a tragedy, it may be another's boon, for if they have forged a strong spiritbond with their gear, it may become infused with the wearer's aether upon his death, rendering it that much more powerful.

29.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_202
29.description: What I find fascinating though is the tremendous variety to be found. Ah, but I suppose it is the inevitable result of glamour prisms becoming so popular with adventurers.

30.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_203
30.description: In any case, should you have no need of these items, House Haillenarte would be most grateful for the contribution.

31.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_204
31.description: Our spoils traders will recompense you for any such gear with sky pirate spoils. Mayhap you are unfamiliar with the currency?

32.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_205
32.description: They are trophies, after a fashion. Items taken from the airships raided in the Sea of Clouds. A bit barbaric, perhaps, but as they are already in common use... <sigh>

33.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_AURVAEL_000_206
33.description: And should you wish to part with your newfound spoils, you may exchange them for an assortment of goods by speaking with one of our spoils collectors.

34.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_100_000
34.description: Certain gear obtained during the course of an exploratory mission can be exchanged for <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>brass sky pirate spoils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> by speaking with spoils traders in Ishgard, the Diadem, or in any residential district.

35.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_100_001
35.description: Moreover, Disciples of the Land can gather <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>steel sky pirate spoils<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> in the Diadem.

36.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_100_002
36.description: These spoils can then be redeemed for a variety of valuable goods by speaking with spoils collectors, who can be found in the company of spoils traders.

37.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDENTRANCE_00311_SYSTEM_000_200
37.description: You cannot register for an exploratory mission while using the Duty Finder.
